skills.name: start-implementation-stage
skills.description: Use on explicit invocation to prepare and execute exactly one user-authorized HOI4 Factory implementation stage. Read the stage packet, prior evidence, instructions and config, define scope, and stop at that stage handoff. Do not use a roadmap reference as implementation authority.

skills.name: validate-stage
skills.description: Use automatically before every stage handoff, or on request, to review one HOI4 Factory stage against its acceptance rows, changed artifacts and actual evidence. Distinguish pass, fail, unavailable and not applicable. Do not claim game behavior from source checks or authorize the next stage.

skills.name: capture-engineering-lessons
skills.description: Use at every substantive handoff, after a repeated failure or tool quirk, or when the maintainer states a preference about how the project is built. Apply useful lessons directly to CLAUDE.md and the skills, create new skills when a workflow repeats, and ask the maintainer only for changes that would widen authority, cost or scope.

skills.name: audit-hoi4-integrations
skills.description: Use on explicit invocation for a bounded source, configuration or capability audit of HOI4 Mod Setup, Agentic HOI4 Modding and domain tools. Pin sources and classify evidence. Do not install, enable remote services or run paid or effectful tools by implication.

skills.name: production-readiness-review
skills.description: Use at a stage handoff, before real users can reach a deployment, or when asked what is worth hardening next. Treat the production readiness checklist as a menu, not requirements, recommend only proportionate low-friction items, and leave enterprise and compliance items alone unless the maintainer asks.

skills.name: delegate-parallel-work
skills.description: Use when a stage splits into independent packets for subagents. Create worktrees from the repository root, write self-contained briefs with owned paths and checks, pick Haiku or Sonnet by task, review and merge each branch into main, then remove its worktree and branch.

skills.name: ui-design-iteration
skills.description: Use when a browser client page is designed or redesigned. Build three or four working variants in the development-only design lab, let the maintainer choose, implement the chosen one with i18n and accessibility intact, record the decision, and move to the next page.

skills.name: track-issues
skills.description: Use when a problem found in a session cannot be fixed in that session, at every stage handoff, and when picking up a tracked issue. File it as a GitHub issue in the repository it belongs to (hoi4-factory, hoi4-agent-tools, the kit, HOI4 Mod Setup or hoi4-imagegen-mcp) with evidence, an owner, the reason it is not fixed now and an acceptance check, then fix tracked issues later with a regression test and close them with evidence. Fix everything you can in the session instead of filing it.

skills.name: coordinate-sessions
skills.description: Use only when the maintainer explicitly asks a session to coordinate large work that runs as many parallel sessions across the HOI4 projects. Run one coordinator that starts, answers, resumes and archives the work sessions, keep a private status page current through an hourly check-in, and hand over to a fresh coordinator when its context grows long.

skills.name: prepare-promotion-release
skills.description: Use when the maintainer names a tool or the whole modder workflow for promotion. Release every promoted tool and its installers at the latest version, clean their public text, draft the video for the maintainer's review and hand over a short list, never posting anything.
